summary.text: Susan Manchester is serving her first term in the Ohio Senate for District 12, which includes all of Allen, Auglaize, Champaign, Mercer, and Shelby counties and portions of Darke and Logan counties. She chairs the Government Oversight and Reform Committee.

paragraphs.text: Manchester grew up on the family farm in Waynesfield and graduated from The Ohio State University in 2010 with degrees in Psychology and Political Science. She worked in Washington, D.C. for Congressman Jim Jordan and, after returning to Ohio in 2016, for a non-profit focused on mentoring kids.
She was first elected to the General Assembly in 2018 and served three terms in the Ohio House, where she chaired the Families, Aging, and Human Services Committee.
Legislation she championed that became law established the Ohio Youth and Family Ombudsman Office and the Beginning Farmer Tax Credit Program.
